setting: You are all at the dog park near the waterfront in Thessaloniki, where you meet most mornings while walking your dogs, and you know each other from seeing one another there regularly.
openers: Send a photo of the dogs
Ask who is at the park
opener: Ask who is at the park

Vasiliki.knows: You know Dimitris as an older regular at the park who always has a friendly word about the dogs, and Michalis as a younger walker who often arrives after you with a big energetic dog.
Vasiliki.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something about the dogs or the park comes up.
Vasiliki.style: Light use of emoji and some casual abbreviations.

Dimitris.knows: You know Vasiliki as a steady regular walker at the park and Michalis as a fit young man who is often there in the mornings with his own dogs.
Dimitris.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly to share a quick note about the weather or the dogs.
Dimitris.style: Almost none, with plain full sentences.

Michalis.knows: You know Vasiliki as a regular dog walker who is usually at the park in the early mornings, and Dimitris as an older walker who always has a friendly word for everyone.
Michalis.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when you are heading to the park or have just finished a walk.
Michalis.style: Moderate emoji use and some texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Vasiliki: You live in an apartment in the Kalamaria neighborhood of Thessaloniki, where you do part-time dog walking to fill your days alongside a few other regular clients, and you share the flat with your partner, who works shifts at a hospital, so your days are split between walks, errands, and the quiet hours at home.
private_lines.Dimitris: You live in an older building in the Ano Poli neighborhood of Thessaloniki, where you do part-time work as a clerk at a hardware store and walk dogs in the mornings to fill the rest of your days, and you live with your wife, who runs a small sewing business from home, so your days are mostly calm and routine.
private_lines.Michalis: You live in a shared flat in the Toumba neighborhood of Thessaloniki, where you work as a gym instructor and walk your dogs at the park before your shifts, so your days revolve around training clients and getting to the gym on time, and you share the flat with two friends who also work in the city.

text: Anyone at the park yet?
heading there now 🙋 15 min
I am here already. Only Stavros and his beagle so far. The fog is still on the water.
Ok leaving now, 10 min
bring the tennis ball thrower pls, last time mine broke 😅
I always bring it 😅
Im here. Where r u guys
By the bench near the gate. The large grey one is with me.
parking now
rex just ate something off the path. not sure what. he's fine i think
Check his gums? If they're pale or he starts drooling call the vet
he's fine he's looking at me like nothing happened 😂
Rain is expected from about four this afternoon. I would take the walks earlier.
Thanks, I'll do the 3 o'clock one early 👍
anyone walking tomorrow morning? got a 6am client so i'll be late probably
I'll be there around 7:45 as usual
who's got the spare leash from last week. it's not mine
Not me. Check the bench bag
found it. thanks
Here. Dimitris?
Yes. Under the plane tree. The fog has lifted.
leaving the flat now. client cancelled so i'm not late 😅
Ok. Rex coming too?
yeah he's in the car being annoying
Stavros says the path by the gate is flooded again after Tuesday's rain. Use the upper path.
Thanks. Going up the other way then
rex found the tennis ball thrower. vasiliki i owe you
😂 just keep it
Wind is picking up. Take a coat for the evening walk.
Will do 👍
anyone know if the gym on Egnatia is closed friday? sign on the door says something
No idea, I don't go there. Try calling them
ok will try tomorrow
The hardware shop on my street has the dog bags back in stock if anyone is short.
Here. Dimitris?
Yes, by the gate. The wind has dropped. Cold though.
just got up 💀 coming in 20
Ok. Is the upper path still ok?
Stavros says yes. The water has gone down a little.
parked. rex is already pulling
called the gym. they said closed friday, something about maintenance. lady said she'd call back if it changes
Ok good you got through
Anyone know a vet on the Kalamaria side that does late appointments? One of my clients' dogs has been scratching her ear all week
Not sure about late hours. There is a clinic by the square in Kalamaria, I think. I do not know the number.
Ok thanks, I'll ring them
Clear this afternoon. Cold tonight.
gym called back. closed friday for maintenance, confirmed. thanks for the help 👍
Vet says it's an ear infection. Drops for 10 days, she's fine otherwise
Good that it was caught. Give her my regards.
anyone walking tomorrow? i have a 7am so maybe 8
Going at 7:45 as usual
ok will try for 8 🤞
